name: Blind Gammer
place: the queen of the rats in the spoil heaps around Copperdell; miners leave cheese at the old adit
_doc: Stream E (M2). A rat the size of a pony who cannot see. She finds you by sound: her Shriek is a cone, she calls the swarm (an interruptible squeak), and at half health she sits on a heap and the swarm comes in waves while she gnaws a stack mark — share it.

party.solo: Solo is rough: the stack mark wants a partner (it still lands, just harder).
party.m5: M5 adds health per extra player and one more copy of the spread/scatter shapes for parties of 4-5; mechanics stay the same.

pull: Something big sniffs the air. "Who's that? I can HEAR you."
The spoil heap squeaks. All of it.
say.death: Blind Gammer squeals once and rolls over. The swarm scatters into the dark.
say.reset: Gammer shuffles back into her heap.

shriek.name: Blind Shriek
shriek.say: Gammer turns her head toward the sound of {target}!

squeak.name: Call the Swarm
squeak.say: Gammer squeaks for her children — interrupt her!

mark.name: Gnawing Mark
mark.say: Gammer has a taste for {target} — stand with them!

phases.name: The Swarm
phases.say: Gammer climbs her heap and the whole hill squeaks!
